body:
Pastors Retreat :: Transforming Leadership

Four focused days with Brian McLaren & Jacqui Lewis

January 22-26, 2018

St. Charles Ave. Baptist Church

New Orleans, LA

 Our week will combine fun and respite with study, worship, and conversation – all in the heart of the Crescent City. Each day, we’ll consider one or more From/To transformationsin pastoral leadership, such as:

 • From organized religion to organizing religion

• From pastor of the congregation to pastor from the congregation to the community

• From service provider to messenger/motivator/model

• From expectation meeter to expectation setter

• From money-avoider to money-addresser

• And more!

 Additionally, our retreat occurs just prior to the beginning of Mardi Gras, therefore it is important that you book your accommodations as soon as possible. St Charles Ave. Baptist Church is located right on the St Charles Ave Streetcar line.

 RESERVE YOUR SPOT NOW

 4 p.m. on January 22 –

12 p.m. on January 26, 2018

 St. Charles Ave. Baptist Church

7100 St Charles Ave.

New Orleans, LA

  

 Your retreat fees include 4 intensive days of study, worship and conversation.

 Use the code NOLA2018 to receive a $250 discount off the cost of your retreat fee, making your cost only $750*.

 *does not included travel, lodging or meals
